run_card.hypothesis: 61-channel 100% 1m-LiDAR-free Seamless 10 m USGS 3DEP Monoclinal Step-Asymmetry x 19-band Crustal Strain/Seismic x GDR #1391 Hydrothermal Conduit Dual-Objective OOF Detector: unidirectional 30-50 m monoclinal step index (dem10_onesided3 * log1p(hgm50_max) * steep_ratio) and 900 m 8-azimuth monoclinal lineament coherence resolve degraded Pleistocene piedmont scarps and all 1,641,254 cells of the 31.8% 1 m LiDAR gap without 1 m LiDAR parent-convergence, fused via log-odds geometric blending of a dual-negative (d3+d9) core classifier and a 300 m triangular-kernel soft-label regressor with unconditional nuisance logit debiasing and Two-Regime 300 m submodular coverage.
run_card.mechanism: Monoclinal normal and transtensional fault scarps create monotonic 30 m elevation steps (dem10_onesided3 -> 1) laterally coherent over >=900 m above basin-margin gravity slopes (iso_grav_anom_slope) and active GPS/microseismic strain zones (geod_2ndinv, deq_n100a15), whereas symmetric desert washes, gullies, and highway borrow ditches reverse slope within 30 m (dem10_onesided -> 0, curv_absmax high). Withholding all 15 1 m LiDAR channels eliminates the 68.2% block-seam and breaks >75% 3-px dot convergence onto DPRF1.
run_card.named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan / Bonneville pluvial wave-cut shoreline benches (unidirectional 10-30 m steps along equipotential contours), resistant Tertiary welded ash-flow tuff hogback dip-slopes, and highway cut-and-fill embankments along valley corridors.
